title: Hackers Put AI Agents on Autopilot to Steal Gaming Accounts and Apple Signing Certificates
content_md: ARTEX, a Chinese open-source agentic penetration-testing platform, to run autonomous attacks. The operators set a goal and then mostly check progress. Researchers identified 2,557 systems that host or hosted ARTEX panels, and 1,608 were live and public. Ten misconfigured instances exposed their full databases. Those databases show the models, prompts and actions behind the campaigns.
